method: A code-path review of the action contract at lane head 3c13c4bd, after the red-first test was measured failing: the register input structs are compared with the schemars 1.2.3 derive's requiredness rule, and the refusal is reproduced by the test before the fix and required to pass after it.

findings.title: registers.list refuses every bare filter, blocking the register read and the promotion replay
findings.evidence: At lane head 3c13c4bd, invoking registers.list with {} and with a valid programme_id both return 422 'the input does not match the action schema'. crates/actions/src/spine/mod.rs:699-708 declares RegisterListIn with three Option fields and no #[serde(default)]; the same omission is on RegisterCreateIn (:631-665) and RegisterUpdateIn (:668-696). schemars 1.2.3 derives requiredness from the field's default/option rule (schemars_derive schema_exprs.rs:728-739), so the generated input marks those fields required. The red-first test crates/actions/tests/registry.rs::registers_list_accepts_its_filters was committed at 5d51531a and fails at this head. The defect blocked scripts/promote-record.py --apply against the staging record and every checker that lists a register.
findings.acceptance: cargo-guard.py test -p conveyor-actions --test registry registers_list_accepts_its_filters exits 0; the generated schema carries no required entry for the register filter inputs; conveyor admin actions dump is regenerated and served-spec.lock.json --check-lock exits 0; a journal entry's input validates against its action schema.
